$comment: Prose only. The scale arrays that used to live here (typeScale, fontSizes, fontWeights, lineHeights, letterSpacings) were a hand-maintained THIRD copy of the type scale with no importers, and they had drifted: the display entry's weightToken said weight.medium while its own usage string said "Plus Jakarta Sans bold 700", and semantic.typography.display points at weight.bold. Six of the tokens they named no longer exist. Removed in hds#283 with the --hds-font-size-* block, for the same reason. The live scale is hirobius.tokens.json, rendered by src/stories/type-specimen.stories.tsx, which reads it at runtime and therefore cannot say something the tokens do not. Keep prose here; never re-add numbers.

definition.summary: Typography is a closed system: one body font, one display font for display and titles, one mono font, and a fixed set of semantic composite tokens.

rules.rule: Use Sora for all text. Display, title and title-sm use Sora 700 and differ by size; body, ui and caption are 400 (Regular), bold text 700, with -0.01em tracking on the text roles (ADR-063).
Use semantic.typography.* composites for text styling instead of raw font values.
Skip Tailwind font utilities. Use hds.typeStyles.* inline style objects.
Use IBM Plex Mono for token chips, inline code, file paths, and technical metadata.
